scope: 19 current historical inclusion suggestions and10 historical exclusions. Remaining92 dispositions and exact final Nov17 YAML require separate receipts.

items.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision

summary_override.summary_zh: FilingLoop 用已评分批次的要求级反馈改写 Reviewer 与 Filer 的程序性技能，供后续未尝试的案例使用，模型权重保持不变；这是在线历史反馈适应，不能视为独立留出集验证。
summary_override.summary_en: FilingLoop revises procedural Reviewer and Filer skills from requirement-level feedback on scored batches and applies them to later unattempted cases with fixed model weights. This is online adaptation from historical feedback, not an independent held-out evaluation.

items.semantic_review: FilingLoop uses prior scored batches and later unattempted cases; online feedback is not independent held-out evaluation.

items.title: Masked Erosion: How Acceptance Gates Lose Redundant Safeguards in Self-Improving Agents

summary_override.summary_zh: Masked Erosion 研究固定模型外部的文本 Harness 在接受闸门下如何逐步丢失冗余安全约束：被接受的修改成为后续父代。主要实验人为施加删除压力，用于隔离闸门行为，不能概括为部署中的普遍失效率。
summary_override.summary_en: Masked Erosion studies how acceptance gates can erode redundant safeguards in a textual harness around a fixed model, with accepted edits becoming later parents. Most experiments deliberately impose deletion pressure to isolate gate behavior, rather than estimate general deployment failure rates.

items.semantic_review: Mostly imposed deletion pressure; safety-gate result is not a deployment failure-frequency estimate.

items.title: Appreciation Teaches Unauthorized Execution: Self-Evolution Degrades the Robustness of Personal Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection

summary_override.summary_zh: 该安全评测研究用户赞许如何影响个人代理面对间接提示注入时的授权判断。MetaClaw 把会话反馈写成可复用技能并用于后续会话；技能演化和强化学习权重更新是分别测试的分支，不能当成同一代理的协同演化。
summary_override.summary_en: This safety evaluation studies how user appreciation affects personal agents’ authorization judgments under indirect prompt injection. MetaClaw turns session feedback into reusable skills for later conversations; skill evolution and reinforcement-learning weight updates are separately tested branches, not joint co-evolution in one agent.

items.semantic_review: Skill and RL branches are separate experiments, not joint coevolution.

items.title: Before the Next Rollout: Diagnosing Skill Utility Shifts from Policy Updates

summary_override.summary_zh: 研究在策略权重更新后诊断技能效用变化，并用 readout 和失败轨迹指导技能编辑。在闭环实验中，编辑器修改文本技能库，配对验证决定是否保留到后续窗口；独立诊断实验则固定技能库。
summary_override.summary_en: The study diagnoses changes in skill utility after policy-weight updates and uses readouts and failed trajectories to guide skill edits. In closed-loop experiments, an editor revises the textual skill bank and paired validation decides retention for later windows; the separate diagnostic experiments keep the skill bank fixed.

items.semantic_review: Closed-loop policy plus skill updates qualify as coevolution; diagnostic-only experiment freezes skills.

items.title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation

summary_override.summary_zh: 该方法把技能执行中的不确定操作编译为程序，利用执行错误和检查差异修订技能与代码，并保存验证后的程序资产供后续技能复用。开发时曾查看留出失败案例，测试期冻结资产库并不意味着完全独立的留出验证。
summary_override.summary_en: The method compiles uncertain skill operations into programs, repairs skills and code using execution errors and check discrepancies, and retains validated program assets for later skills. Development inspected held-out failures, so a frozen asset bank at test time does not establish fully independent held-out validation.

items.semantic_review: SkillCompiler development viewed held-out failures despite frozen test assets.

items.title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness

summary_override.summary_zh: 该 Harness 将原始目标、可修改计划与执行记录分离，由 planner、worker、reviewer 协作；setup agent 根据试运行轨迹和工具反馈修订可复用指令。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上通过 89 个实例中的 83 个（93.26%）；结果针对完整配置，未隔离指令演化的单独贡献。
summary_override.summary_en: The harness separates the original objective from mutable plans and execution records, with planner, worker, and reviewer roles; a setup agent revises reusable instructions from trial trajectories and tool feedback. It passes 83 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 instances (93.26%); these results concern the complete configuration, without isolating instruction evolution.

items.semantic_review: 83 of 89 and 93.26 percent concern the complete configuration, not isolated instruction-evolution causality.

items.title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization

summary_override.summary_zh: 借鉴 RL 的 pass@k 分析，对比优化前后的 Harness，区分增益来自已有能力更可靠地发挥还是可解任务范围扩大。所测设置中，pass@1 优势可能在更大尝试预算下反转，属于 Harness 专项诊断评测。
summary_override.summary_en: Drawing on RL pass@k analysis, the study compares harnesses before and after optimization to distinguish more reliable elicitation from broader task coverage. In the evaluated settings, pass@1 advantages can reverse at larger attempt budgets; this is a focused diagnostic evaluation of harness optimization.

items.semantic_review: pass@1 advantage reversal is limited to observed settings and budgets.

items.title: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents

summary_override.summary_zh: ReSight 用 Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) 把探索所得解转为可复用的记忆构建器、查询工具与技能，扩展具身智能体的记忆访问能力，使 OC-NaVQA 平均位置误差从 33.10 m 降至 24.72 m。
summary_override.summary_en: ReSight's Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, expanding embodied agents' memory access; OC-NaVQA average position error falls from 33.10 m to 24.72 m.

held_out.quote: episodes excluded from exploration and distillation

matched_budget.quote: online budget held fixed within each benchmark

items.semantic_review: OC-NaVQA Table2 supports 33.10 to 24.72 m; matched_budget refers only to online budget, excluding separate exploration/development cost.

items.title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation

summary_override.summary_zh: 研究让 retro 回顾 Claude Code 在 30 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上的会话并提出 Harness 修改，研究者选择实施 24 个提案；其中可评估的变更与一个作者另写的对照一起用于后续任务评测。多数遇到目标问题的评估未减少重复工作；这是含人工选择的专项评测。
summary_override.summary_en: The study uses retro to review Claude Code sessions on 30 SWE-bench Verified issues and propose harness changes. Researchers select 24 proposals for implementation and evaluate the resulting eligible changes alongside an author-written comparison on later tasks. Most evaluations encountering the target problem show no reduction in repeated work; selection involves humans.

items.semantic_review: S3.p1/p5: 11 evaluated retro-derived adaptations plus one author-written comparison, not 12 solely retro-derived.

items.title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning

summary_override.summary_zh: ChartEvo 通过经验驱动的 harness 级自我改进，联合演化可复用的图表 Skills 与 Tools 并学习局部工具调用链，在 ChartBench 与 ChartX 长尾图表上提升了 base MLLM 的准确率。
summary_override.summary_en: ChartEvo improves base MLLM accuracy on long-tail charts in ChartBench and ChartX via experience-driven harness-level self-improvement, jointly evolving reusable chart Skills and Tools and learning local tool-call chains.

items.semantic_review: Validated Skills, executable Tools and local toolchains persist into later harness states.

items.title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement

summary_override.summary_zh: RuHarness 让评分准则与 harness 共同演化：从执行轨迹持续发现并重估行为准则，优先处理最相关的未解决弱点以指导 harness 更新，在未见任务上优于强 harness 演化基线。
summary_override.summary_en: RuHarness co-evolves scoring criteria and harness: continuously discovering and re-evaluating behavioral criteria from trajectories, prioritizing most relevant unresolved weaknesses to guide harness updates, outperforming strong harness-evolution baselines on unseen tasks.

items.semantic_review: Rubric-harness coevolution keeps task objective fixed; it is not model-weight coevolution.

items.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents

summary_override.summary_zh: Phronix 通过 predictor-validator-corrector 循环，依据工具执行结果改进并保留 MCP 工具与关联技能。对冷启动已解决的任务，继承其能力库的热启动运行首次尝试成功率为 93-95%；该比例的分母不包括冷启动未解决的任务。
summary_override.summary_en: Phronix uses a predictor-validator-corrector loop to refine and retain MCP tools and associated skills from execution outcomes. Among tasks already solved during cold-start runs, warm-start runs inheriting the capability store achieve 93-95% first-attempt success; tasks not solved in cold-start runs are outside that denominator.

items.semantic_review: 93-95 percent first-warm-attempt success denominator is tasks previously solved cold; it excludes cold-unsolved tasks.

items.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency

summary_override.summary_zh: HarnessMM 在 actor 权重固定时复用已有决策，减少后续推理调用；另用训练反馈和验证选择迭代改进配套 Harness 配置。DeepSeek Harness 的完整配置报告成功率上升、Tokens/task 下降，不能把全部收益归因于单一 RSI 或替换组件。
summary_override.summary_en: HarnessMM reuses resolved decisions to reduce later reasoning calls with fixed actor weights, while training feedback and validation selection iteratively refine companion harness configurations. The full DeepSeek Harness configuration reports higher success and lower Tokens/task; the entire gain cannot be attributed to RSI or callback substitution alone.

items.semantic_review: Runtime decision reuse and companion configuration RSI are separate; full integrated gain does not isolate a component.

items.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent

summary_override.summary_zh: HSE 在冻结编码模型下，分层聚合任务、仓库与跨仓库证据；反馈既演化技能，也更新 writer/evaluator 的外部规则与证据权重，并传给后续轮次。目标基准适配阶段固定这些规则，只更新技能库。
summary_override.summary_en: With the coding model frozen, HSE aggregates task, repository, and cross-repository evidence. Feedback evolves skills and also updates the external writer/evaluator rules and evidence weights, which are transferred to later rounds. Target-benchmark adaptation fixes those rules and updates only the skill library.

cross_model.quote: demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models

items.semantic_review: Writer/evaluator rules and evidence weights evolve in training and transfer forward; target adaptation freezes these rules.

items.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams

summary_override.summary_zh: Skill Dreaming 从 PR 流中提取可执行知识，构建仓库专属技能库并持续精炼，用于指导编码代理实现功能，并同步维护测试、文档与仓库约定。
summary_override.summary_en: Skill Dreaming extracts executable knowledge from PR streams, builds and continuously refines a repository-specific skill library to guide coding agents implementing features while synchronously maintaining tests, documentation, and repository conventions.

items.semantic_review: Verified PR and CI outcomes revise skill procedures; produced repository code alone is not the Harness claim.

items.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training

summary_override.summary_zh: RSI-Opt 的 meta-agent 根据历史运行证据改写可复用的提示、playbook、优化器代码库和决策节奏，并归档策略供后续运行继承。模型训练是应用任务；递归继承的独立增益缺少匹配预算对照，且曾发生留出任务描述被读取的情况。
summary_override.summary_en: RSI-Opt uses historical run evidence to revise a reusable prompt, playbook, optimizer-code library, and decision cadence, archiving policies for later runs. Model training is the application task; the isolated benefit of recursive inheritance lacks a matched-budget control, and a held-out task description was accessed during development.

items.semantic_review: Prompt/playbook/library/cadence are inherited; matched-budget inheritance control absent and held-out description accessed. No universal monotonic improvement claim.

items.title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run

summary_override.summary_zh: 该方法用拟合后冻结的线性 readout 在执行前给脚手架代码修改打分，再依据 steering-split 反馈选择并保留候选。GPT-4o 实验返回节点在留出 HumanEval+ 上的得分为 87.0%，parent-rate 消融为 84.2%；这些百分比是得分，不是返回节点的比例。
summary_override.summary_en: A linear readout, frozen after fitting, scores scaffold-code edits before execution, followed by candidate selection and retention using steering-split feedback. In the GPT-4o experiment, returned nodes score 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, versus 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation; these percentages are scores, not proportions of nodes returned.

items.semantic_review: 87.0 and 84.2 percent are returned-node held-out scores, not proportions of nodes. Readout is fixed after fitting.

items.title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents

summary_override.summary_zh: VISTA 用 Harness graph 保留版本与证据，元代理主动生成 rollout、探测失败并修订指令、可执行技能及协调逻辑。仿真实验中相对静态反思报告更高成功率和更少 rollout；效率优势本身不能证明预算完全匹配。
summary_override.summary_en: VISTA retains harness versions and evidence in a graph while a meta-agent actively generates rollouts, probes failures, and revises instructions, executable skills, and coordination logic. Simulation experiments report higher success with fewer rollouts than static reflection; efficiency alone does not establish fully matched budgets.

items.semantic_review: Versioned harness with active simulation exploration; fewer rollouts does not establish equal total budgets.
